narrative: Own-fleet fuel of €15.3M plus €10.4M of fuel in subcontractor rates, against €23.9M of fuel surcharge billed. Recovery fell to 91% in 2026 from 96% in 2025 because the Q1 spike reached the surcharge two months late on 24% of Key Account contracts.

signals.title: Q1 diesel spike: surcharge recovered two months late
signals.source: SDP agency margin monitor — CNR diesel index vs fuel surcharge (synthetic data)
signals.excerpt: The CNR diesel index rose about 20% between January and March 2026 (€1.52 → €1.82 per litre). The fuel surcharge followed with a two-month lag, so about €0.7M of agency contribution margin was lost in Q1.

signals.title: FY2027: diesel +15% with a two-month lag costs €1.67M of EBITDA
signals.source: SDP scenario model — FY2027 Budget base
signals.excerpt: Fuel cost rises €4.0M; the surcharge recovers €2.3M. EBITDA margin falls from 6.2% to 5.6%. A monthly CNR reset limits the hit to €1.2M.
